pm_structure.summary: General account is managed predominantly in-house by Manulife's investment organisation, with Global WAM (Manulife Investment Management) managing C$234.4bn of general-fund assets for the insurance segments; corporate CIO (Trevor Kreel) sets ALM/SAA at MFC level.
manager_entities: Manulife Investment Management (Global WAM segment) - public and private markets
bullets: Global WAM managed C$234.4bn of general-fund assets for other segments at 2025-12-31; intersegment fee revenue earned (FY2025 MD&A).
ALDA (C$61.7bn, 13% of GA) is 'majority managed in-house'; timber/ag via MIM Timberland & Agriculture; RE 43% US / 38% Canada / 19% Asia.
Corporate CIO sits on Executive Leadership Team, reports to CEO; distinct from MIM public/private markets CIOs who report into Global WAM.
Recent construct changes: CQS (2024) and Comvest (75%, closed Q4 2025) add external credit/private-credit capabilities; L&G partnership (Mar 2026).

rotation_commentary.text: ALDA returns below long-term expectations drove C$1,662m market experience charge (RE, PE, timber); management retains ALDA strategy but trims RE exposure.
Six commercial real estate dispositions (C$0.36bn) in 2025; RE occupancy 82%; office exposure under review.
LTC/legacy reinsurance (Global Atlantic 2024, RGA Jan 2025) released capital and reduced ALDA/long-duration asset need; proceeds to buybacks (NCIB).
Private placements C$51.8bn (11%) and mortgages 12% remain core yield assets; MBS/ABS small at C$2.3bn (1%).
Comvest acquisition (75%) adds US middle-market private credit origination; GA expected to seed/co-invest (inferred).
Encumbered cash/securities C$17.9bn and repo usage up (C$1,422m vs C$193m Dec 2025) as collateral/liquidity management grows.

target_allocations.target: No numeric target disclosed; ALDA 13% of GA at 2025-12-31 (RE 12.7, infra 18.6, timber/ag 6.0, PE 18.4, energy 1.7, other 4.3 C$bn).
Core ROE 18%+, leverage <=25%, 50% core earnings from Asia, 25%+ from Global WAM by 2027.

debt_outstanding.type: Preferred shares and other equity instruments (incl. LRCNs)

securities_lending.text: Securities lent C$3,113m (C$1,800m at 2025-12-31); collateral typically 102-105%, over-collateralization C$527m. Program via custodians.

repos.text: Securities sold under repurchase agreements C$1,422m (C$193m Dec 2025); reverse repos C$905m; encumbered cash and securities C$17.9bn.

structured_indirect.text: Mortgage- and asset-backed securities C$2.3bn (1% of GA) at 2025-12-31; no CLO breakout disclosed.
Fund investments (infrastructure, timber, PE, private credit funds) C$35,758m within ALDA/other invested assets.
Credit-linked notes / variable surplus notes with unconsolidated financing entity for US LTC reserve financing (letters-of-credit substitute).
Credit default swaps written limited to notional not exceeding government bond holdings; CDS used as credit replication.
Reinsurance of US LTC/legacy blocks to Global Atlantic (2024) and RGA (2025) transferred ~C$8.4bn of LTC reserves off balance sheet (asset-intensive).

bank_relationships.text: Exclusive bancassurance partnerships reach 35m+ bank customers, incl. regional exclusive deal with DBS (Singapore, HK, mainland China, Indonesia); Mahindra India JV announced Nov 2025.
Canadian bank syndicate (RBC, Scotia, TD, CIBC, BMO) rotates as leads on CAD capital issues; US bulge bracket (BofA, Citi, JPM, MS) on USD.
DBS also acts as joint lead manager on MFC's SGD subordinated issues (2024, 2026) alongside the distribution partnership.

appetite: Board-approved Risk Appetite Framework: capital adequacy, earnings volatility, liquidity, strategic/reputational limits; exposure limits by risk type.
ERM framework with five components (governance, appetite, identification, measurement, control/monitoring); risk-adjusted return in pricing and capital allocation.
Market-risk limits on equity, interest-rate, ALDA and FX exposures measured via earnings-at-risk and LICAT sensitivity.
governance: Board Risk Committee (BRC) oversees ERM; Executive Risk Committee (ERC) manages global risk profile; oversight sub-committees (credit, ALCO, operational, tech/cyber).
CRO Halina von dem Hagen leads Global Risk Management (second line); Three Lines model with Audit as third line.
FCT (Financial Condition Testing) 2025 completed with capital above internal targets in all scenarios; ORSA and Economic Capital models in place.
risk.capital_target: Internal capital targets set above OSFI supervisory target (100%) and minimum (90%); numeric operating range not disclosed. MLI LICAT 136% at 2026-06-30.
sensitivities: Equities -10%: net income ~-C$450m after hedging and reinsurance (2025-12-31).
Interest rates +/-50bp parallel: net income approx. +/-C$100m (2025-12-31).
hedging: Variable annuity / seg-fund guarantee dynamic hedging program (delta/rho) plus macro equity hedges.
Interest-rate swaps and swaptions for duration matching; CDS as credit replication (notional capped at govt bonds).
Reinsurance of LTC/legacy blocks (Global Atlantic, RGA) used as structural risk transfer.
